integrity: Exact combinatorial recursion and independent arrival-time integration agree on the full occupation law and all nineteen site probabilities; standard-library verifier and exact LCF graph construction are included. No independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result is a finite 19-site monomer nearest-neighbor exclusion process; not a thermodynamic, time-resolved, or all-regular-graph statement. Earlier unindexed exact tabulations may exist. Full text of Pippenger (1989) was inaccessible; its abstract was compared. General RSA recurrences and the Robertson graph are prior work, not claimed new.
title: Exact monomer-adsorption jamming law on the Robertson (4,5)-cage
